variants.name: 沉浸封面
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a HIGH-FIDELITY, finished, polished mobile app page design, not a wireframe.
Product: 同拍, a playful synchronized walking / rhythm-practice app.
Output: ONE single tall portrait smartphone app screenshot, approximately 9:19.5 aspect ratio. Edge-to-edge screen UI only, no physical phone mockup, no hand, no desktop, no comparison board. Render legible crisp Chinese UI and beautifully composed spacing.
Input image: the attached screenshot is the CURRENT app's saved-to-album page. Use it as the visual identity reference and source for the SAME existing sunset seaside video thumbnail (orange sunset, teal sea, comic walkers on beach). The screenshot's old platform row is obsolete and MUST be REMOVED.
Brand style: warm ivory paper #FFF9EE background, near-black #171B1F ink, bold slightly italic Chinese heading, clean thick comic contours, very restrained hard offset shadows, coral #FF7056 for the SINGLE primary action, lavender #C5B7EB only as an accent. Friendly editorial comic style, excellent production UI, not childish clutter. Use existing actual seaside cover content, no new unrelated illustrations or mascots.
The page is a full-screen SUCCESS PAGE AFTER the video has been saved to the album.
Content requirements: top safe area and simple native status bar 9:41; clear back arrow returning to works; small app name "同拍"; exact status title "已保存到相册"; real video thumbnail with a small "00:19" duration chip; optional metadata "单人练习 · 00:19"; EXACTLY ONE share action button with the label "分享". Its icon is a simple UPWARD arrow over an open tray (the app's save icon with only the arrow direction reversed).
Button behavior, represented by the design: opens the system share sheet. Do not show the system sheet open in this screenshot.
ABSOLUTE EXCLUSIONS: NO platform logos, NO individual WeChat/QQ/Weibo/Xiaohongshu destinations, NO 更多 button, NO second share action, NO share calendar, NO calendar grid, NO check-in/activity/reward content, NO floating modal over another page, NO screenshot of a works list, NO save button (saving is already complete), NO extra calls to action such as replay/delete/record again.
Keep all controls touch-friendly, realistic screen-scale type, no need for an exaggerated enormous title. Bottom safe area / home indicator included. Do not put design variant labels or any English commentary inside the app screenshot.

LAYOUT A — IMMERSIVE COVER, QUIET VERTICAL RHYTHM:
A light ivory full-screen page. Top back arrow left and small 同拍 right. Centered status heading "已保存到相册" below, with a very small teal confirmation tick, and one quiet subtitle "留住这一拍，分享给同频的人。".
The MAIN VISUAL is a generously sized tall portrait video thumbnail centered in the middle of the page, about 66–70% screen width, with a thin black contour, modest 8px corner radius, tiny offset ink shadow. Keep the source video's portrait aspect and full visible beach scene, not a horizontal crop. Duration chip on lower right.
One FULL-WIDTH coral 分享 button near the bottom, left/right aligned to 24px screen gutters, around 54px tall, bold dark label and small black up-arrow/tray icon. Below it a tiny neutral hint "选择一个平台，分享这一拍". Strong hierarchy with plenty of breathing room, compact enough that the whole page and its one button fit one phone screen without scrolling. Make the thumbnail the protagonist and keep all other elements simple.

LAYOUT B — COMIC TICKET / ONE COHESIVE SAVED-WORK CARD:
Warm ivory full-screen page, top back arrow and 同拍 branding. Left-aligned bold title "已保存到相册" near the top, one small teal check as a confirmation accent.
Build ONE distinctive, carefully designed cream ticket-like card in the center. It is not a floating modal. The card has a confident near-black thin outline, a restrained HARD black offset backing, tiny inward semicircular notches at the divider, and a subtle lavender tab peeking behind one corner. The card's lowest section contains the ONE coral primary 分享 button, almost full card width, with the upward arrow/open-tray icon. Integrate the button naturally with the card. No additional button outside the card. Below the card, a quiet small sentence "把这一拍，分享给同频的人。". Maintain a strong original-app comic identity with a purposeful ticket silhouette and clear single-action focus. Entire design fits one phone viewport.

Center a tall portrait seaside video cover there, approximately 61% screen width, black thin outline and a compact 00:19 chip.
